# stackhero_stack (Resource)

A Stackhero stack. The stack must be empty before deletion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stackhero_stack" "example" {
  name = "redis-example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stack name. Changing this value requires replacement.

### Optional

- `organization` (String) Organization name or ID. Omit when the account has one organization. Changing this value requires replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stackhero stack ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import stackhero_stack.example stk-123456
```
